bifrost: nothing (Apple Music is an Apple subscription service with no BifrOSt counterpart); the nearest local pieces are springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music.rs (Radio tab, internet radio streams) and springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (player capsule)
summary: MusicKit is the client for Apple Music's catalog, subscriptions and tokens, which only exist as an Apple online service. BifrOSt has no catalog, subscription or Apple Music token layer, so nothing maps to it; local playback is covered by the Media Player row of the matrix instead.

features.note: Requires the Apple Music catalog API; no BifrOSt catalog service.

features.feature: Music items (Song, Album, Artist, Playlist, Station ...)
features.apple: Album, Artist, Song, Playlist, Station, Track
features.note: Catalog item model belongs to Apple Music. Local library items are a separate concern (Media Library row).
Apple ID and Apple Music subscription offers; BifrOSt Cloud accounts (bifrost-cloud) do not sell music.

features.apple: MusicTokenProvider, MusicDeveloperTokenProvider, automatic developer token generation
features.note: Tied to the MusicKit App Service in the Apple developer portal.
Playback of Apple Music catalog items needs the catalog service. The audio client plays local and stream media only.
Artwork is supplied by the Apple Music catalog; BifrOSt apps draw their own artwork.
Raw calls to the Apple Music API. Generic HTTP is in the URL session SDK (springboard/sdk/src/url.rs), but there is no Apple Music endpoint.

gaps: No Apple Music catalog, subscription or token service; out of scope for a Linux desktop.
Apps that expect MusicKit can use the local Media Player and radio paths instead; the matrix does not treat that as parity.
